open_items.decision: D4 form: extensions of existing shared skills only (SD-018), or extensions plus one thin shared entry-point skill (owner's latest words "Just create the shared skill please").
open_items.recommendation: **A — extensions only.** `setup-pre-commit` becomes the shared CI/CD gate skill and is already linked into every harness; a second entry-point skill would only route to the three extended skills and duplicate their trigger surface, which C10 forbids. If "the shared skill" meant one new named skill, option B costs one light slice (S41, `skills/ci-cd/SKILL.md`, a router under 25 lines) and changes nothing else.

open_items.decision: Build the optional AI excitement commentary (would load `typesafe-ai`)?
open_items.recommendation: No. Fixed templates driven by the excitement-level setting (AC-AFC-ALERT-05) meet item 3 without a new provider or credential before T_deadline.

open_items.decision: Alexa voice spike (C8) as a stretch slice after M3?
open_items.recommendation: Yes, as stretch only: started after M3 exit if every M4 slice is on schedule, dropped at 2026-10-21T12:00:00Z if unverified.

open_items.decision: Spike slices on the heavyweight lane run as evidence-only investigations rather than test-first pairs.
open_items.recommendation: Yes. Spikes write verdict files and throwaway probes under `spikes/`; production code that follows a spike uses the lane's `tdd` strategy.

`.gitignore` `*.log` hides specialist logs cited as evidence.

open_items.decision: D5 trigger boundary: the new `spec-authoring` skill owns Markdown section-sourced specifications; `use-requirements-system` keeps SDoc/Requirements System specifications. Add the reciprocal non-trigger to `use-requirements-system`'s description in the same D5 PR?
open_items.recommendation: Yes. Both descriptions today would match "write the architecture specification"; one line in each description removes the collision (RISK-AFC-15). Without it, S06 edits only the new skill and records the residual collision.

open_items.decision: D5 shape: one skill `spec-authoring` (author, figure and lint procedures; figure and lint detail in `references/`) versus three skills mirroring GridMarket (`spec-author`, `spec-diagram`, `spec-lint`).
open_items.recommendation: One skill. The three share one trigger surface and one toolchain; one `SKILL.md` within skill_size_max plus references keeps the catalog lean (C10).

open_items.decision: Vendor the D5 scripts (MIT-derived from public GridMarket) into this repository's `tools/spec/` so public CI can run the `spec` gate area, given Alphazedehq is private.
open_items.recommendation: Yes. The scripts derive from public MIT code; SD-011 already publishes this repository's contents; the MIT notice travels in `VENDORED.md` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

open_items.decision: In a repository without a Vnv guidance tree, does `ship-pull-request`'s `REFUSED_NO_VNV` block the merge (SM finding F10)?
open_items.recommendation: No. Record `REFUSED_NO_VNV` as a non-pass gate row in the PR (C12) and let the repository's own required checks decide the merge; blocking would stop merges in every repository the owner touches (SD-019) until each gains a tree. This repository has a tree (SD-014), so its merges always run `vnv-review`.
